title: SATURDAY EASY CARDIO
subtitle: SATURDAY. EASY CARDIO, TIMED. SINGLE-LEG HINGE FOR BALANCE, STEP-UPS AND MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS ON THE CLOCK, LIGHT GLUTE BRIDGES. THEN CAT-COW AND A HAMSTRING STRETCH. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. SATURDAY. EASY CARDIO. SIXTEEN MINUTES. SINGLE-LEG HINGE FOR BALANCE, STEP UPS AND MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS ON THE CLOCK, LIGHT GLUTE BRIDGES. THEN WE UNSTICK THE BACK AND THE HAMSTRINGS. STEADY PACE. NOT A BLOODY SPRINT.
script.start: MOVE. CLOCK IS RUNNING. YOU ARE NOT.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. HANDS OFF THAT BLOODY PHONE.
script.lastSet: LAST SET. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. HEART WOKE UP, BALANCE HELD, BACK AND HAMSTRINGS OPEN. GO ENJOY THE DAY LIKE A MAN WHO CAN STILL MOVE. IF I CATCH YOU FOLDED INTO THAT SOFA LIKE A DISCARDED JUMPER I WILL KNOW. I ALWAYS KNOW.

exercises.name: SINGLE-LEG HINGE
exercises.cue: STAND ON ONE LEG, SOFT KNEE. HINGE AT THE HIPS, SEND THE FREE LEG STRAIGHT BACK, TORSO FOLLOWS UNTIL YOU FEEL THE STANDING HAMSTRING AND GLUTE WORK. KEEP THE HIPS SQUARE TO THE FLOOR. RETURN TALL. EIGHT EACH LEG. LIGHT FINGERTIP TOUCH ON A CHAIR IF YOU NEED IT — BALANCE FIRST, DEPTH SECOND.
exercises.speakStart: SINGLE-LEG HINGE. THREE SETS. EIGHT EACH LEG. STAND TALL. HINGE. FREE LEG BACK. HIPS SQUARE. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. A BLOODY FLAMINGO WITH STANDARDS, NOT A WOBBLY LAMP POST.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. SWITCH LEGS WHEN YOU'RE READY. EYES ON YOU.
exercises.speakDone: HINGES DONE. BALANCE SWITCHED ON. GOOD.

exercises.name: STEP-UP (TIMED)
exercises.cue: USE A STURDY LOW STAIR OR STEP. DRIVE THROUGH THE WHOLE FOOT OF THE LEAD LEG, STAND TALL ON TOP, THEN STEP DOWN WITH CONTROL. ALTERNATE LEGS OR STICK TO ONE SIDE THEN SWITCH MID-SET. FORTY SECONDS STEADY — EASY CARDIO PACE, NOT A RACE. CHEST UP, SOFT LANDING.
exercises.speakStart: STEP UPS. THREE SETS. FORTY SECONDS. STEADY PACE. DRIVE UP, STAND TALL, STEP DOWN QUIET. THIS IS THE EASY CARDIO. IF YOU LOOK LIKE YOU'RE FLEEING A BURNING BUILDING I WILL SLOW YOU DOWN MYSELF.
exercises.speakDone: STEP UPS DONE. HEART SAYS HELLO. GOOD.

exercises.name: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS (EASY PACE)
exercises.cue: HANDS ON THE FLOOR OR ON A LOW STAIR IF THE FLOOR IS TOO HARD. BODY IN A STRAIGHT PLANK LINE. DRAW ONE KNEE TOWARD THE CHEST, THEN THE OTHER, ALTERNATING. THIRTY SECONDS AT AN EASY, EVEN PACE — NO SPRINTING. HIPS LEVEL, SHOULDERS OVER WRISTS. BREATHE.
exercises.speakStart: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS. THREE SETS. THIRTY SECONDS. EASY PACE. STRAIGHT LINE. KNEE IN, KNEE OUT. THIS IS NOT A BLOODY CROSSFIT FINAL. STEADY TICKING. I'M WATCHING.
exercises.speakDone: CLIMBERS DONE. LUNGS OPEN. GOOD LAD.

exercises.name: GLUTE BRIDGE
exercises.cue: LIE ON YOUR BACK, KNEES BENT, FEET FLAT UNDER THE KNEES, ARMS BY YOUR SIDES. PRESS THROUGH THE HEELS, SQUEEZE THE GLUTES, LIFT THE HIPS UNTIL SHOULDERS, HIPS, AND KNEES MAKE ONE LINE. PAUSE, LOWER WITH CONTROL. TWELVE CLEAN REPS. NO OVERARCHING THE LOW BACK.
exercises.speakStart: GLUTE BRIDGES. THREE SETS. TWELVE REPS. HEELS DOWN. SQUEEZE. HIPS UP. LIGHT STRENGTH. YOUR BACKSIDE HAS BEEN SITTING ON A CHAIR ALL WEEK LIKE A BLOODY CUSHION. WAKE IT UP.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. STAY ON THE FLOOR. BREATHE.

exercises.name: CAT-COW
exercises.cue: ON ALL FOURS, HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS, KNEES UNDER HIPS. INHALE: DROP THE BELLY, LIFT THE CHEST AND TAILBONE (COW). EXHALE: ROUND THE SPINE, TUCK THE CHIN AND PELVIS (CAT). MOVE SLOW AND EVEN FOR FORTY SECONDS. NO FORCING THE END RANGE. THIS IS MOBILITY, NOT A CIRCUS.
exercises.speakStart: CAT COW. TWO ROUNDS. FORTY SECONDS. ALL FOURS. INHALE OPEN THE CHEST. EXHALE ROUND THE SPINE. SLOW. THAT DESK HAS FOLDED YOU LIKE A CHEAP DECKCHAIR. UNFOLD.

exercises.name: STAIR HAMSTRING STRETCH
exercises.cue: PLACE ONE HEEL ON A LOW STAIR, LEG MOSTLY STRAIGHT, SOFT KNEE. HINGE AT THE HIPS WITH A LONG SPINE UNTIL YOU FEEL A GENTLE STRETCH IN THE BACK OF THE THIGH. HOLD THIRTY SECONDS. SWITCH LEGS. NO BOUNCING. BREATHE INTO THE STRETCH.
exercises.speakStart: STAIR HAMSTRING STRETCH. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH LEG. HEEL ON THE STEP. HINGE. LONG SPINE. GENTLE. THOSE HAMSTRINGS HAVE BEEN SHORT ALL WEEK. GIVE THEM SOME AIR.
exercises.speakDone: HAMSTRINGS OPEN. THAT IS THE LOT. WELL DONE.
